newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Iraq's Aziz to visit Vienna next week - embassy.
newsitem.headline: Iraq's Aziz to visit Vienna next week - embassy.

text.p: Iraq's Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz will visit Vienna early next week, an official at the Iraqi embassy in Vienna said on Thursday, but declined to give any further details.
"Mr Aziz will definitely visit Vienna either on Monday or Tuesday, but I cannot say for what reason," the official told Reuters.
Speculation that Aziz was in Vienna on Thursday to meet Iraqi oil minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed during the meeting of OPEC ministers was incorrect, the official added.
